description.p: Lunduke City 2 is a windowed city-building game for LCOS, Steam Deck, and Windows. It is a hard fork of Lunduke City and keeps the same saved city files. Zone land, lay roads and power, set the budget, and watch the city grow.
Cities are saved as .cty files. Unsaved work is autosaved and offered back after a crash or logout. The original Lunduke City can be installed beside this one.
The first release of Lunduke City 2, an SDL3 game that installs beside Lunduke City and opens the same .cty saves.

ul.li: Learn to Play: a seven-step tutorial city with no deadline
Thirteen scenarios, with new Seattle, San Francisco 1962, Portland and San Diego challenges
Special buildings: Zoo, Amusement Park, Casino, Stadium, Marina, Library, Mayor's House, Data Center, Prison and Micro Nuclear Plant
Year in Review, the Inspect tool, and undo for the last build or bulldoze
Steam Deck, gamepad and touch support, remappable keys, autosave and crash recovery
